asm-aqmt.text: Helps two Security Council committees monitor sanctions against listed individuals and entities linked to ISIL (Da’esh), Al-Qaida or the Taliban.

ceb.text: Brings together the Secretary-General and the heads of UN system organizations to coordinate their policies, programmes and activities.

desa.text: Supports UN talks on sustainable development, analyses global trends and helps countries put international commitments into practice.

dgacm.text: Helps the General Assembly and other UN bodies conduct their work and provides multilingual meeting and document services.

dos.text: Provides operational support to Secretariat entities, including supply chain, human resources, training and health services.

dppa.text: Helps prevent and resolve conflicts through political analysis, mediation, electoral assistance and peacebuilding support.

eca.text: Promotes economic and social development in African member States and fosters regional integration and international cooperation.

ece.text: Helps its member States cooperate and integrate their economies through policy dialogue, common standards and technical advice.

eclac.text: Advances sustainable development in Latin America and the Caribbean through research, technical cooperation and policy advice.

eo.text: Helps UN staff uphold standards of integrity through confidential advice, financial disclosure and work to protect staff against retaliation.

escap.text: Helps countries in Asia and the Pacific pursue sustainable development through research, dialogue and capacity-building.

escwa.text: Helps Arab countries pursue inclusive, sustainable development through policy analysis, technical advice and regional dialogue.

gom-cyprus.text: Helps the two sides in Cyprus build trust and pursue a negotiated settlement through dialogue.

icsc.text: Regulates and coordinates conditions of employment across organizations in the UN common system.

iima.text: Prepares criminal case files on international crimes and grave violations of international law committed in Afghanistan.

iimm.text: Builds case files on the most serious international crimes and violations of international law committed in Myanmar since 2011.

iimp-syria.text: Works to find out what happened to missing people in Syria and where they are, and supports victims, survivors and families.

itc.text: Helps micro, small and midsize businesses in developing countries and economies in transition compete internationally.

jiu.text: Independently inspects and evaluates participating UN organizations, including how they use funds and coordinate their work.

oct.text: Leads and coordinates UN counter-terrorism work and strengthens UN assistance to countries in preventing and countering terrorism.

oda.text: Helps countries cooperate on disarmament, arms control and non-proliferation through dialogue, training and confidence-building.

odpp.locator: XV. Office of Data Protection and Privacy

ola.text: Provides UN legal services, including legal representation, multilateral treaty depositary functions and treaty registration and publication.

osesg-myanmar.locator: 10. Office of the Special Envoy of the Secretary-General on Myanmar

osesg-yemen.locator: 9. Office of the Special Envoy of the Secretary-General for Yemen

osrsg-svc.locator: V. Office of the Special Representative of the Secretary-General on Sexual Violence in Conflict

osrsg-vac.locator: VI. Office of the Special Representative of the Secretary-General on Violence against Children

poe-s-sudan.text: Monitors implementation of the South Sudan sanctions, including the arms embargo, asset freeze and travel ban.

poe-sudan.text: Monitors Sudan sanctions, including the arms embargo, asset freeze and travel ban, and reports on threats to peace in Darfur.

poe-yemen.text: Monitors implementation of the Yemen sanctions, including the asset freeze, travel ban and targeted arms embargo.

sweo.locator: XVIII. United Nations Sustainable Development Group System-Wide Evaluation Office

unctad.text: Helps developing countries participate in and benefit from the global economy to support inclusive, resilient and sustainable development.

unhcr.text: Leads efforts to protect refugees and find lasting solutions, and helps protect stateless and internally displaced people.

unodc.text: Helps countries address drug-related problems, crime, corruption and terrorism, and strengthen their criminal justice systems.

unowas.text: Helps prevent conflict in West Africa and the Sahel through political engagement, mediation support and regional cooperation.

unrcca.text: Helps Central Asian governments identify and address threats to peace and security through preventive diplomacy and regional dialogue.

unsmil.text: Supports Libya’s political transition and post-conflict efforts by helping facilitate an inclusive political process.

untso.text: Helps the parties to the 1949 Armistice Agreements monitor compliance and deploys military observers in the Middle East.
